item.tib: sprul pa'i sku mchog blo ldan snying po'i gsung 'bum las jo mo gnam phyi gung rgyal gyis gdams pa
item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa yang / bka' skyongs rnams la mthol lo bshags/ 'di bris dge ba'i mthun rkyen gyis/ drin chen pha mas thog drang pa'i/ nam mkhas khyab pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ bla med theg chen don rtogs nas/ mthar phyin ye sangs rgyas par shog bstan pa mi g.yung drung bon/ dar rgyas 'phel nas 'gro ba'i don/ dpag med 'gro don bkra shis shog/
